interpretation: RN7 detects several late-stage RN6-style failures at broad/deep screening, but different sample construction and missing RN6 fields prevent a causal or statistical improvement claim.

source_utility.books_and_materials: Best at proving book-format behavior and exposing direct competitors; weak at proving the underlying job alone.
source_utility.service_or_training_spend: Best at proving consequential spending and trigger; does not prove book demand.
source_utility.unmet_need_sources: Useful for generating situations; weakest for willingness-to-pay without independent spending and format evidence.
